metadata.title: Boosta
metadata.description: Boosta is a multi-vendor service marketplace for Kuwait and the GCC.

home.title: The service marketplace for Kuwait & the GCC
home.subtitle: Connect with trusted providers, request quotes, and get things done. Built mobile-first, Arabic-first, and production-ready.
